description: Defines classes and functions for iterating and extracting configuration values related to build targets in the GN build system, including ConfigValuesIterator and functions for writing config values to streams.

classes.name: ConfigValuesIterator
classes.description: An iterator to traverse all ConfigValues applying to a given target, including the target's own config values and those from associated configs.

methods.name: RecursiveTargetConfigToStream
methods.description: Writes config values from a target and its configs to an output stream, optionally skipping duplicates.

methods.name: RecursiveTargetConfigStringsToStream
methods.description: Outputs config values as strings with no transformation, handling duplicates based on configuration.
